description: PageSpeed audit for a site's pages. Without a path: a per-page scoreboard (scores, vitals, top opportunity titles, issue counts), worst pages first. With a path: the full diagnosis for that one page, including the LCP element, prioritised opportunities with estimated savings and the exact offending resources, and the failing accessibility/SEO checks with their elements. Scan the scoreboard, then drill into the page you want to fix.
name: jamp_page_audit
